title: Range against launch angle
brief: Plots: range for u = 20 m/s (no air resistance). Line markers chart. X values: 0°, 15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 75°, 90°. Series 'Range (m)': 0.0, 20.4, 35.3, 40.8, 35.3, 20.4, 0.0
html:
<script>
const data = [[0, 0.0], [15, 20.4], [30, 35.3], [45, 40.8], [60, 35.3], [75, 20.4], [90, 0.0]];
const u = 20, g = 9.8;     // Range series: u = 20 m/s
const u2 = 28;             // Example 3.8 program: u = 28 m/s
let angle = 0;
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 90], y: [0, 45], xLabel: "launch angle θ (°)", yLabel: "range R (m)" });

function rangeAt(a, speed) {
  return speed * speed * Math.sin(2 * a * Math.PI / 180) / g;   // R = u² sin 2θ / g
}

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  const R = rangeAt(angle, u);
  c.fn(x => rangeAt(x, u), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  c.vline(angle, `θ = ${angle}°`);
  c.dots([[angle, R]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  c.label(angle, R, `${R.toFixed(1)} m`);

  // Example 3.8 program logic, evaluated at the same angle with u = 28 m/s
  const th = angle * Math.PI / 180;
  const ux = u2 * Math.cos(th), uy = u2 * Math.sin(th);
  const h = uy * uy / (2 * g);
  const T = 2 * uy / g;
  const Rp = ux * T;
  c.readout([
    `Range, u = 20 m/s: ${R.toFixed(1)} m`,
    `Example 3.8 (u = 28): max height ${h.toFixed(1)} m`,
    `Time of flight ${T.toFixed(1)} s`,
    `Range ${Math.round(Rp)} m`
  ]);
  Visual.state(`At θ = ${angle}°, the range for u = 20 m/s is ${R.toFixed(1)} m; the maximum range of 40.8 m occurs at 45°.`);
}

Visual.on("angle", v => { angle = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
